金属冶炼：电解熔融盐 + 铝热: Metal Smelting: Electrolysis of Molten Salts + Thermite
为什么铝只能靠电「拆」出来，而铁能被铝「换」出来？: Why can aluminum only be "pulled apart" with electricity, while iron can be "swapped out" by aluminum?
金属越活泼，正离子越难得电子: The more reactive the metal, the harder it is for its cation to gain electrons
K–Al 电解 · Zn–Cu 热还原 · Hg/Ag 热分解: K–Al electrolysis · Zn–Cu thermal reduction · Hg/Ag thermal decomposition
Al₂O₃ 要 2054 ℃，靠冰晶石助熔到约 1000 ℃: Al₂O₃ needs 2054 ℃; cryolite as a flux brings it down to about 1000 ℃
槽电压 4 V 以上，吨铝一万多度电；加电流只买产量: Cell voltage above 4 V, over ten thousand kWh per tonne of aluminum; more current only buys output
铝自己活泼 → 铝热把铁换出来: Aluminum itself is reactive → thermite swaps iron out

阳极（+）：O²⁻ 在这里失电子放 O₂: Anode (+): O²⁻ loses electrons here, releasing O₂

铝液从槽底抽出: Liquid aluminum is siphoned from the cell bottom

电解熔融 MgCl₂：阴极得镁: Electrolysis of molten MgCl₂: magnesium at the cathode

一排通着电的电解槽：氧化铝进、铝液出: A row of energized cells: alumina in, liquid aluminum out

铝粉 + 氧化铁在坩埚里烧成铁水: Aluminum powder + iron oxide burn into molten iron in a crucible
电流、槽温、效应报警: Current, cell temperature, anode effect alarm

同样是从矿石里挖出来的金属，为什么有的能「烤」出来，有的只能通电？: These metals all come from ores. Why can some be "baked" out while others need electricity?
拖动视角，在三块台子之间转一圈（滚轮拉近拉远）: Drag the view around the three benches (scroll to zoom)
参考工况 300 kA / 955 ℃：单槽日产铝 2.30 t/d、吨铝直流电: Reference conditions 300 kA / 955 ℃: 2.30 t/d of aluminum per cell and DC consumption of 12 861 kW·h/t; the potline, the molten salt bench and the thermite bench are all set out
冶炼的实质：把金属从其化合物里还原出来: The essence of smelting: reducing the metal from its compounds
K Ca Na Mg Al → 电解: K Ca Na Mg Al → electrolysis
Zn Fe Sn Pb Cu → 热还原: Zn Fe Sn Pb Cu → thermal reduction
① 金属在自然界主要以正价化合物（矿物）存在，少数以单质存在，要从正价变零价必须: ① In nature most metals exist as compounds in positive oxidation states (minerals), a few as elements; going from positive to zero requires gaining electrons.
② 金属越活泼、还原性越强，它的正离子越难得电子，就越难被还原——方法不是背的，: ② The more reactive and reducing a metal is, the harder its cation gains electrons and the harder it is to reduce; the methods are not memorized but ranked by reactivity.
③ 所以 K、Ca、Na、Mg、Al 只能电解熔融盐，Zn→Cu 用热还原，Hg: ③ So K, Ca, Na, Mg and Al can only be made by electrolysis of molten salts, Zn→Cu by thermal reduction, Hg and Ag by thermal decomposition, and Pt and Au need only physical concentration.
④ 去掉这一步：学生只会背「铝用电解法」，说不出凭什么。: ④ Skip this step and students can only recite "aluminum uses electrolysis" without saying why.
常考「冶炼方法的选择依据」：答金属活动性（还原性强弱），不要只答「看价格」。: A common question: the basis for choosing a smelting method. Answer with metal reactivity (reducing strength), not just "price".
冶炼的实质是把金属从化合物里还原出来；金属越活泼，正离子越难得电子，方法就按活动: Smelting reduces the metal from its compounds; the more reactive the metal, the harder its cation gains electrons, so methods line up by reactivity: K–Al electrolysis, Zn–Cu thermal reduction, Hg/Ag thermal decomposition.
焦炭能从铁矿石里把铁换出来，为什么换不出铝？: Coke can swap iron out of iron ore. Why can't it swap out aluminum?
在 3D 里点一下对照台左边那台钠电解槽的阴极引出铜排（凸在槽壁外那块）: In 3D, click the cathode copper bar sticking out of the wall of the sodium cell on the left of the comparison bench
点开后横幅点出：NaCl 801 ℃、MgCl₂ 714 ℃ 自己熔了就能导电，: The banner then shows: NaCl at 801 ℃ and MgCl₂ at 714 ℃ conduct once melted, cathode Na⁺ + e⁻ → Na; but Al₂O₃ melts only at 2054 ℃ and needs cryolite as a flux
熔融盐自身就是离子导体；Al₂O₃ 要加冰晶石才熔: A molten salt is itself an ionic conductor; Al₂O₃ needs cryolite to melt
① 按金属活动性顺序，铝排在碳的前面：铝的还原性比碳强，碳在工业可行的温度下还原: ① In the reactivity series aluminum comes before carbon: aluminum is a stronger reducer, so carbon cannot reduce Al₂O₃ at industrially feasible temperatures.
② 把方向倒过来也不行：用铁去还原氧化铝，ΔrG° = +840.1 kJ·mo: ② Reversing the direction does not work either: reducing alumina with iron has ΔrG° = +840.1 kJ·mol⁻¹ > 0, not spontaneous.
③ 钠、镁、铝都靠电解熔融盐，但 NaCl 801 ℃、MgCl₂ 714 ℃: ③ Sodium, magnesium and aluminum all rely on electrolysis of molten salts, but NaCl (801 ℃) and MgCl₂ (714 ℃) conduct once melted while Al₂O₃ melts only at 2054 ℃, so cryolite must be added to bring the melt temperature down.
④ 去掉这一步：学生会以为「铝只是更贵一点」，不知道它根本不在同一条还原路线上。: ④ Skip this step and students think "aluminum is just a bit more expensive", not realizing it is not on the same reduction route at all.
常考「为什么铝不能像铁那样用还原剂冶炼」：答金属活动性（铝比碳、比铁活泼），不要: A common question: why aluminum cannot be smelted with a reducing agent like iron. Answer with reactivity (aluminum is more reactive than carbon and iron), not "aluminum is expensive".
铝比碳、比铁都活泼，碳还原不了氧化铝，铁也换不动铝（ΔrG° = +840.1: Aluminum is more reactive than both carbon and iron: carbon cannot reduce alumina and iron cannot displace aluminum (ΔrG° = +840.1 kJ·mol⁻¹ > 0, not spontaneous), so sodium, magnesium and aluminum can only be made by electrolysis of molten salts.
这台槽子里面到底有什么，铝是怎么「长」出来的？: What is actually inside this cell, and how does aluminum "grow"?
槽子已朝镜头剖开四分之一，拖动视角绕它看一圈: A quarter of the cell is cut away toward the camera; drag the view around it
剖开后看到：顶插的预焙阳极碳块、铺在槽底的阴极碳块、中间橙红的熔融电解质、槽底沉: Inside: prebaked carbon anodes inserted from the top, cathode carbon blocks lining the bottom, orange-red molten electrolyte in between, a silver-white layer of liquid aluminum at the bottom, and bubbles at the anode faces
阳极碳块从上方插入熔体 · 阴极碳块铺在槽底: Anode carbon blocks inserted from above · cathode carbon blocks line the bottom
阳极在上：顶插碳块: Anodes on top: carbon blocks inserted from above
阴极在槽底：碳块铺底: Cathode at the bottom: carbon blocks lining it
① 阳极是一排预焙碳块，从上方插进熔体；阴极碳块铺在槽底、连着槽底的钢棒。: ① The anode is a row of prebaked carbon blocks inserted into the melt from above; cathode carbon blocks line the bottom, connected to steel bars in the cell floor.
② 中间是熔融电解质：冰晶石里溶着 2–4 % 的氧化铝，温度在 940–980: ② In between is the molten electrolyte: 2–4 % alumina dissolved in cryolite at 940–980 ℃.
③ 铝液密度 2.3 g/cm³ 比熔体 2.1 g/cm³ 大，所以沉在槽底，: ③ Liquid aluminum (2.3 g/cm³) is denser than the melt (2.1 g/cm³), so it sinks and is siphoned from the bottom, not "scraped out".
④ 去掉这一步：铝「怎么出来」讲不清，学生会以为铝浮在上面。: ④ Skip this step and how aluminum "comes out" is unclear; students may think it floats on top.
常考「电解炼铝的阴极产物在哪」：槽底（密度大于熔体），阳极在熔体上方、产物是 O: A common question: where is the cathode product in aluminum electrolysis? At the bottom (denser than the melt); the anode is above the melt and its product is O₂.
电解槽就是一台电解熔融盐的装置：阳极碳块在上、阴极碳块在槽底，铝液因为比熔体重而: The cell is an apparatus for electrolyzing molten salt: anode carbon on top, cathode carbon at the bottom, and liquid aluminum sinks to the bottom because it is heavier than the melt, where it is siphoned off.
通了电以后，电子和离子各自往哪边走？加大电流能省电吗？: Once current flows, which way do electrons and ions go? Does more current save power?
把系列电流从 300 kA 拖到 400 kA，盯住产量和吨铝电耗: Drag the potline current from 300 kA to 400 kA, watching output and power per tonne
Al³⁺ 向下（阴极在槽底）、O²⁻ 向上（阳极在上方）；I 300 → 400: Al³⁺ moves down (cathode at the bottom), O²⁻ moves up (anode on top); I 300 → 400 kA: output per cell 2.30 → 3.06 t/d, cell voltage 4.100 → 4.180 V, power per tonne 12 861 → 13 112 kW·h/t
直流电 · 阳极碳块同时被烧掉：C + O₂ → CO₂: Direct current · the carbon anodes burn away at the same time: C + O₂ → CO₂
Al³⁺ ↓ 去槽底阴极: Al³⁺ ↓ to the cathode at the bottom
O²⁻ ↑ 去顶插阳极: O²⁻ ↑ to the anodes on top
P ∝ I，W 随 I 略升: P ∝ I; W rises slightly with I
① 熔体里阳离子往下走、阴离子往上走；外电路的电子由电源负极经槽底母线进来、从顶: ① In the melt cations move down and anions move up; in the external circuit electrons come from the supply's negative terminal through the bottom busbar and return from the anode rods on top to the positive terminal.
② 阴极是 Al³⁺ 得电子（不是 O²⁻）；阳极放氧，氧立刻烧掉灼热的碳阳极，: ② At the cathode Al³⁺ gains electrons (not O²⁻); the anode releases oxygen, which immediately burns the hot carbon anode, using 0.4–0.5 kg of carbon per kg of aluminum.
③ 电流越大，单位时间得电子越多、出铝越多：产量与电流成正比，300 → 400: ③ More current means more electrons gained per unit time and more aluminum: output is proportional to current, 2.30 → 3.06 t/d for 300 → 400 kA.
④ 去掉这一步：学生会以为「电流越大越省电」——实际上欧姆压降随电流增大会把槽电: ④ Skip this step and students think "more current saves power"; in fact the ohmic drop grows with current and pushes the cell voltage up, so power per tonne rises from 12 861 to 13 112 kW·h/t.
常考「电解铝加大电流会怎样」：产量成正比增加，槽电压与吨铝电耗随之上升；省电要靠: A common question: what happens if the current is increased? Output rises proportionally, and cell voltage and power per tonne rise with it; saving power needs lower cell voltage and higher current efficiency.
阴极 Al³⁺ + 3e⁻ → Al、阳极 2O²⁻ − 4e⁻ → O₂↑；电: Cathode Al³⁺ + 3e⁻ → Al, anode 2O²⁻ − 4e⁻ → O₂↑; more current makes more aluminum, but also bigger ohmic drops in busbars, rods and melt. Power per tonne depends mainly on cell voltage and current efficiency and is not saved by a larger current.
氧化铝 2054 ℃ 才熔化，槽子怎么撑得住？: Alumina melts only at 2054 ℃. How can the cell cope?
把「冰晶石助熔」切到未投用，看读数全掉下来，再切回来: Switch "cryolite flux" to off, watch all readings drop, then switch it back
关掉冰晶石：熔点 2054 ℃ 远高于本槽上限 990 ℃，电解直接停——单槽日: Without cryolite the melting point of 2054 ℃ is far above this cell's 990 ℃ limit, so electrolysis stops: output 2.30 → 0.00 t/d, cell voltage 0 V; switch back and it recovers to 2.30 t/d / 4.100 V
冰晶石 Na₃AlF₆ 熔点 1012 ℃ · 熔体工作在 940–980 ℃: Cryolite Na₃AlF₆ melts at 1012 ℃ · the melt works at 940–980 ℃
熔剂不写进总式: The flux is not written in the overall equation
① 纯 Al₂O₃ 熔点 2054 ℃，直接熔了再电解，能耗和设备都撑不住。: ① Pure Al₂O₃ melts at 2054 ℃; melting it directly for electrolysis would be too much for both energy and equipment.
② 冰晶石（Na₃AlF₆，熔点 1012 ℃）把氧化铝溶进去，混合熔体温度降到: ② Cryolite (Na₃AlF₆, m.p. 1012 ℃) dissolves alumina, bringing the mixed melt below about 1000 ℃; industry actually runs at 940–980 ℃.
③ 冰晶石是熔剂：降低熔化温度、增加导电性，理论上不被消耗（实际有挥发损失要补加: ③ Cryolite is a flux: it lowers the melting temperature and increases conductivity, and in theory is not consumed (in practice volatilization losses are topped up), so it is not written in the overall reaction.
④ 去掉这一步：学生不理解「为什么 2054 ℃ 的东西能在 950 ℃ 的槽里: ④ Skip this step and students cannot see how something that melts at 2054 ℃ is electrolyzed in a 950 ℃ cell.
常考「冰晶石的作用」：熔剂，降低氧化铝的熔化温度（不是催化剂、不参与电极反应）。: A common question: the role of cryolite. It is a flux that lowers alumina's melting temperature (not a catalyst, and not part of the electrode reactions).
冰晶石把 Al₂O₃ 的熔化温度从 2054 ℃ 拉到约 1000 ℃ 以下，工: Cryolite brings the melting temperature of Al₂O₃ from 2054 ℃ down below about 1000 ℃, so industrial electrolysis can run at 940–980 ℃; it is a flux and is not written in the overall equation.
槽温只差十几度，为什么电费差一大截？: The cell temperature differs by only fifteen degrees. Why is the power bill so different?
把槽温从 955 ℃ 拖到 940 ℃，看槽电压和吨铝电耗: Drag the cell temperature from 955 ℃ to 940 ℃ and watch cell voltage and power per tonne
t 955 → 940 ℃：槽电压 4.100 → 4.245 V、吨铝直流电耗: t 955 → 940 ℃: cell voltage 4.100 → 4.245 V, DC power per tonne 12 861 → 13 068 kW·h/t, current efficiency 95.0 → 96.8 %, output 2.30 → 2.34 t/d
另加欧姆项 0.0008·(I − 300)；低于 950 ℃ 再加 0.010: Plus an ohmic term 0.0008·(I − 300); below 950 ℃ add a 0.010/℃ term for the thickening melt
① 槽温降低，Al₂O₃ 溶不动、熔体变黏、电阻变大，槽电压升高，吨铝电耗跟着升: ① Lower the cell temperature and Al₂O₃ dissolves poorly, the melt thickens and resistance rises, so cell voltage and power per tonne rise: 12 861 → 13 068 kW·h/t for 955 → 940 ℃.
② 槽温升高，槽电压是降了一点（约 3 mV/℃；低于 950 ℃ 则反过来，按: ② Raise the cell temperature and the voltage falls a little (about 3 mV/℃; below 950 ℃ it goes the other way via the 0.010/℃ thickening term), but current efficiency drops faster (η only 0.908 at 990 ℃), so consumption rises to 13 111, and lining erosion speeds up.
③ 所以工业守在 940–980 ℃、把电耗压在 11 500–13 500 k: ③ So industry stays at 940–980 ℃ and keeps consumption at 11 500–13 500 kW·h/t; textbook Fig. 8-2 gives an older figure of about 16 500 kW·h/t, and modern cells have come down to this range. This lesson's reference value of 12 861 is 1.48 times the theoretical minimum of 8700.
④ 去掉这一步：学生只会背「电解铝费电」，不会算「调几度、多花多少」。: ④ Skip this step and students only recite "aluminum electrolysis uses a lot of power", unable to calculate "a few degrees cost how much more".
常考「电解铝的电耗为什么这么高」：槽电压比理论分解电压高得多，多出来的都变成热。: A common question: why aluminum electrolysis uses so much power. The cell voltage is far above the theoretical decomposition voltage, and the excess all becomes heat.
槽温降 → Al₂O₃ 溶不动、熔体电阻大 → 槽电压升 → 吨铝电耗升（955: Lower cell temperature → Al₂O₃ dissolves poorly, higher melt resistance → higher cell voltage → higher power per tonne (12 861 → 13 068 kW·h/t for 955 → 940 ℃); a temperature too high lowers voltage, but current efficiency drops faster (0.908 at 990 ℃ → 13 111). Both ends waste power, so industry stays at 940–980 ℃.
铝这么难弄出来，为什么还能拿它去炼铁？: If aluminum is so hard to get out, why can it be used to make iron?
看着镁条被引燃：铝热剂开始反应，铁水从坩埚底流进型腔: Watch the magnesium ribbon ignite: the thermite starts reacting and molten iron flows from the bottom of the crucible into the mold
坩埚里白亮光、火花四溅，温度到 2500 ℃ 以上（超过铁熔点 1535 ℃）：: Brilliant white light and sparks fly in the crucible, above 2500 ℃ (higher than iron's 1535 ℃ melting point): molten iron sinks into the mold with Al₂O₃ slag floating on top; ΔrH° = −851.5 kJ·mol⁻¹
ΔrH° = −851.5 kJ·mol⁻¹ · 引燃后靠自身放热维持: ΔrH° = −851.5 kJ·mol⁻¹ · once ignited it sustains itself with its own heat
① 铝热里铝被氧化（0 → +3）、铁被还原（+3 → 0），铝是还原剂——方向: ① In thermite, aluminum is oxidized (0 → +3) and iron reduced (+3 → 0); aluminum is the reducing agent, exactly the opposite direction from step 2.
② 反应剧烈放热（ΔrH° = −851.5 kJ·mol⁻¹），只需引燃，之后: ② The reaction is strongly exothermic (ΔrH° = −851.5 kJ·mol⁻¹); it only needs ignition, then sustains itself, reaching above 2500 ℃.
③ 温度超过铁熔点 1535 ℃，铁以液态流出、沉在下面，Al₂O₃ 熔渣浮在上: ③ Above iron's 1535 ℃ melting point, iron flows out as liquid and sinks while Al₂O₃ slag floats on top: used for welding rails and smelting refractory metals.
④ 去掉这一步：「铝很活泼」只讲成负担，讲不出它最有用的地方。: ④ Skip this step and "aluminum is very reactive" is only a burden, without its most useful side.
常考「铝热反应的氧化剂是谁」：Fe₂O₃（Fe 由 +3 → 0）；铝热可焊接钢: A common question: what is the oxidizing agent in thermite? Fe₂O₃ (Fe goes from +3 → 0); thermite can weld rails and smelt refractory metals.
同一个「铝很活泼」：电解时是麻烦（必须用电硬拉），铝热时是本钱（铝把铁从氧化物里: The same "aluminum is very reactive": in electrolysis it is a nuisance (electricity must force it out), in thermite it is an asset (aluminum seizes iron's oxygen), releasing 851.5 kJ·mol⁻¹ at above 2500 ℃.
产量、电耗、槽子安全同时卡着，你把这台槽调成什么样？: With output, power use and cell safety all constrained, how do you set up this cell?
在槽温 950–965 ℃ 内，把吨铝电耗压到 ≤ 13 100 kW·h/t、: Within a cell temperature of 950–965 ℃, bring power per tonne to ≤ 13 100 kW·h/t and output per cell to ≥ 2.30 t/d, and hold for 15 s
进入 5 s 后夜班会把槽温降到 935 ℃：300 kA 时电耗 13 241: 5 s in, the night shift drops the cell temperature to 935 ℃: 13 241 kW·h/t at 300 kA and 13 290 at 320 kA, both above 13 100 and outside the temperature band; you must pull it back. When on target the goal bar turns green
三项同时成立并保持 15 s: All three met and held for 15 s
① 电耗线 ≤ 13 100 把低温那一端卡死：930 ℃ 时是 13 441: ① The power line ≤ 13 100 shuts the low-temperature end: 13 441 kW·h/t at 930 ℃ and 13 241 at 935 ℃, both too high.
② 产量线 ≥ 2.30 t/d 把电流下界卡在 305–310 kA；温度越高: ② The output line ≥ 2.30 t/d sets the lower current bound at 305–310 kA; the hotter the cell, the lower the current efficiency and the more current needed to keep output.
③ 槽温上界 965 ℃ 卡在电流效率与槽衬安全上；越过 985 ℃ 会走「3: ③ The upper temperature bound of 965 ℃ is set by current efficiency and lining safety; above 985 ℃ you get "3 s countdown → lining eroded through → accident → review → repair".
④ 去掉考核：学生只会背「950 ℃ 左右」，不会同时守住三条线。: ④ Without the check, students only recite "around 950 ℃" and cannot hold three lines at once.
常考「电解铝为什么不能一味降温省电」：槽电压升、熔体变黏、氧化铝溶不动。: A common question: why can't the cell just be cooled to save power? Cell voltage rises, the melt thickens and alumina will not dissolve.
可行域是一条二维窄带：只有槽温 950–965 ℃、电流够大又不过大时才三项同时: The feasible region is a narrow 2D band: only at 950–965 ℃ with a current large enough but not too large are all three met; the threshold is calculated, not memorized.
吨铝直流电耗: DC power per tonne of aluminum
冰晶石未投用：氧化铝没熔化，无电流通过: Cryolite off: alumina has not melted, no current flows
吨铝电耗与日产 — 槽温: Power per tonne and output vs. cell temperature
过热度越大越危险，985 ℃ 越界: The greater the superheat the more dangerous; limit 985 ℃
本班目标：槽温 950–965 ℃ 内，吨铝电耗 ≤ 13 100 kW·h/t: Class goal: within 950–965 ℃, power per tonne ≤ 13 100 kW·h/t and output per cell ≥ 2.30 t/d, held for 15 s
槽温过高 → 槽衬蚀穿 → 熔体渗漏: Cell too hot → lining eroded through → melt leaks
A. 为了降槽电压、省电，把槽温一路往上推: A. To lower cell voltage and save power, the cell temperature is pushed up and up
槽电压确实降了，但过热度变大：铝在熔体里的溶解损失增加，侧壁炭块被侵蚀加快。: Cell voltage does fall, but superheat grows: more aluminum dissolves back into the melt and the sidewall carbon erodes faster.
B. 越过 985 ℃，侧壁结壳被烧穿: B. Above 985 ℃ the sidewall ledge burns through
侧壁靠一层凝固的「边部结壳」保护；过热后结壳化掉，炭块直接接触熔体与空气。: The sidewall is protected by a layer of frozen "side ledge"; with superheat the ledge melts and the carbon touches melt and air directly.
C. 槽衬蚀穿，电解质与铝液渗到槽壳: C. The lining erodes through; electrolyte and aluminum seep to the shell
槽壳发红、温度骤升，本该被槽壳温度监测抓到并报警。: The shell glows red and its temperature jumps; shell temperature monitoring should have caught it and raised an alarm.
D. 联锁未动作，槽壳被烧穿: D. The interlock fails and the shell burns through
本演示预设了联锁失效；现实处理是立即降电流、抬极距、必要时停槽。: This demo assumes the interlock fails; in reality you would cut current at once, raise the anode distance and stop the cell if needed.
槽温按工艺规程守在 940–980 ℃，不为了省电越过上限: Keep cell temperature at 940–980 ℃ per the operating procedure; don't exceed the limit to save power
槽壳温度在线监测 + 侧壁温度超限报警，定期测炉帮厚度: Online shell temperature monitoring + sidewall overtemperature alarm; measure ledge thickness regularly
电流、槽温、氧化铝浓度联锁：异常时先降负荷，不硬撑: Interlock current, cell temperature and alumina concentration: cut load first when abnormal, don't push on
冰晶石与氟化铝配比按电解质初晶温度调整，别让过热度过大: Adjust the cryolite and aluminum fluoride ratio to the electrolyte's liquidus so superheat stays small
定期检查阳极与侧壁，发现结壳变薄就安排检修: Inspect anodes and sidewalls regularly; schedule repairs when the ledge thins
记住这条链：槽温越高 → 槽电压越低但过热度越大 → 边部结壳化掉 → 槽衬蚀穿: Remember the chain: hotter cell → lower voltage but more superheat → side ledge melts → lining erodes through and leaks. Save power by lowering cell voltage, not by running hot.
本课目标：搞清「为什么铝只能电解」和「电耗的账怎么算」，最后在温度带里把吨铝电耗: Lesson goal: understand "why aluminum can only be made by electrolysis" and "how the power account works", then within the temperature band bring power per tonne below 13 100 and output above 2.30 and hold for 15 s.
电解熔融氧化铝时，阴极和阳极的产物分别是: In the electrolysis of molten alumina, the products at the cathode and anode are
阴极（接电源负极）Al³⁺ + 3e⁻ → Al；阳极（接正极）2O²⁻ − 4: Cathode (to the negative terminal) Al³⁺ + 3e⁻ → Al; anode (to the positive terminal) 2O²⁻ − 4e⁻ → O₂↑. The O₂ released then burns the carbon anode, but the electrode product itself is O₂.
冰晶石在电解炼铝中的作用是: The role of cryolite in aluminum electrolysis is
催化剂，加快铝离子得电子: A catalyst that speeds up electron gain by aluminum ions
熔剂，降低氧化铝的熔化温度: A flux that lowers the melting temperature of alumina
还原剂，把铝还原出来: A reducing agent that reduces aluminum
燃料，提供反应热: A fuel that supplies reaction heat
冰晶石（Na₃AlF₆，熔点 1012 ℃）是熔剂：把 Al₂O₃ 溶进去，混合: Cryolite (Na₃AlF₆, m.p. 1012 ℃) is a flux: it dissolves Al₂O₃ and brings the mixed melt below about 1000 ℃ (940–980 ℃ in industry). It takes no part in the electrode reactions and is not written in the overall equation.
工业上不能用焦炭还原氧化铝制铝，主要原因是: Industry cannot make aluminum by reducing alumina with coke mainly because
铝比碳活泼，碳在工业可行温度下还原不了 Al₂O₃: Aluminum is more reactive than carbon, so carbon cannot reduce Al₂O₃ at industrially feasible temperatures
焦炭会与铝生成合金: Coke would form an alloy with aluminum
按金属活动性顺序铝在碳之前，铝的还原性比碳强；把方向倒过来（用铁还原氧化铝）Δr: In the reactivity series aluminum comes before carbon and is the stronger reducer; reversing the direction (reducing alumina with iron) has ΔrG° = +840.1 kJ·mol⁻¹ > 0, also not spontaneous. So only electrolysis of molten salt works.
其他条件不变，把系列电流从 300 kA 加到 400 kA，单槽日产铝和吨铝电: With everything else unchanged, raising the potline current from 300 kA to 400 kA changes output per cell and power per tonne how?
产量升、吨铝电耗不变: Output rises, power per tonne unchanged
产量升约 4/3、吨铝电耗也升一点: Output rises by about 4/3, power per tonne also rises a little
产量升、吨铝电耗降: Output rises, power per tonne falls
产量不变、吨铝电耗升: Output unchanged, power per tonne rises
产量与电流成正比（2.30 → 3.06 t/d）；但母线、导杆与熔体的欧姆压降: Output is proportional to current (2.30 → 3.06 t/d); but the ohmic drops in busbars, rods and melt grow with current, cell voltage goes 4.100 → 4.180 V, and power per tonne rises slightly from 12 861 to 13 112 kW·h/t.
铝热反应 2Al + Fe₂O₃ → Al₂O₃ + 2Fe 中，铝: In the thermite reaction 2Al + Fe₂O₃ → Al₂O₃ + 2Fe, aluminum is
铝由 0 价升到 +3 价，失电子、被氧化，做还原剂；铁由 +3 降到 0 价，: Aluminum rises from 0 to +3, losing electrons and being oxidized, so it is the reducing agent; iron falls from +3 to 0 and is reduced. Thermite releases 851.5 kJ·mol⁻¹ and can weld rails and smelt refractory metals.
电解熔融 NaCl 与电解 NaCl 水溶液，阴极产物分别是: The cathode products of electrolyzing molten NaCl and aqueous NaCl are respectively
熔融得 Na、水溶液得 H₂: Na from the melt, H₂ from the solution
熔融得 H₂、水溶液得 Na: H₂ from the melt, Na from the solution
熔融 NaCl 里只有 Na⁺ 和 Cl⁻，阴极 Na⁺ + e⁻ → Na；水: Molten NaCl contains only Na⁺ and Cl⁻, so the cathode gives Na⁺ + e⁻ → Na; in solution H₂O gains electrons more easily than Na⁺, so the cathode releases H₂ and forms NaOH. That is the whole point of the word "molten".
槽温从 955 ℃ 降到 940 ℃，吨铝电耗为什么反而升高: Why does power per tonne rise when the cell temperature drops from 955 ℃ to 940 ℃?
因为熔体变黏、电阻变大，槽电压从 4.100 V 升到 4.280 V: Because the melt thickens and its resistance rises, raising cell voltage from 4.100 V to 4.280 V
W = 2980·U/η，槽温降到 940 ℃ 时 Al₂O₃ 溶不动、熔体电阻: W = 2980·U/η; at 940 ℃ Al₂O₃ dissolves poorly and melt resistance rises, so cell voltage goes 4.100 → 4.245 V; although current efficiency rises to 96.8 %, consumption still rises from 12 861 to 13 068 kW·h/t.
为什么「槽温越低越省电」这个说法不对: Why is "the colder the cell, the more power it saves" wrong?
因为低温时产量会掉到零: Because output drops to zero at low temperature
因为降温让槽电压升高、电耗先撞 13 100 线，而升温又让电流效率掉、产量不够: Because cooling raises cell voltage so power hits the 13 100 line first, while heating lowers current efficiency so output falls short
因为低温时冰晶石会分解: Because cryolite decomposes at low temperature
因为低温时阳极不导电: Because the anode stops conducting at low temperature
两头的账都要算：降到 930 ℃ 电耗 13 441 kW·h/t（熔体变黏），: Both ends of the account count: at 930 ℃ power is 13 441 kW·h/t (thick melt), at 990 ℃ current efficiency is only 0.908 and power 13 111, both above 13 100. The feasible region is just the narrow band of 950–965 ℃ and 305–400 kA.
阴极选中：NaCl 熔了就能导电，阴极 Na⁺ + e⁻ → Na；Al₂O₃: Cathode selected: NaCl conducts once molten, cathode Na⁺ + e⁻ → Na; Al₂O₃ melts only at 2054 ℃
冰晶石已切断：Al₂O₃ 熔点 2054 ℃ 远高于槽温上限，熔体凝固，电解停止: Cryolite cut off: Al₂O₃'s 2054 ℃ melting point is far above the cell limit, the melt freezes and electrolysis stops
冰晶石已投用：混合熔体降到约 1000 ℃ 以下，电解恢复: Cryolite on: the mixed melt drops below about 1000 ℃ and electrolysis resumes
异常：夜班把槽温降到 935 ℃（300 kA 时电耗 13 241 kW·h/: Fault: the night shift dropped the cell temperature to 935 ℃ (13 241 kW·h/t at 300 kA, above 13 100); pull it back yourself
达标：电耗、产量、槽温三条线同时守住，保持 15 s: Passed: power, output and cell temperature lines all held for 15 s
已回到参考工况：300 kA、955 ℃、冰晶石投用: Back to reference conditions: 300 kA, 955 ℃, cryolite on
紧急停车：工况已降回参考值，联锁解除: Emergency stop: conditions back to reference values, interlock released
抢修完成：补炉帮、复位参数，重新开车: Repair done: ledge restored, parameters reset, restarted
